name: SDC Display
description: Integrates fields and view modes with single directory components.
project_description:
This module allows site builders to leverage the components available in the site inside the Manage Display tabs of your entities. With SDC Display you will be able to configure what component an individual field uses, or what component a given view mode uses.

 
 Did you know? 
 You can map the rendered value of a field to a component at 3 different levels:

 
 At the field level. 
 At the field group level, using the Field Group module . 
 At the entity level. 
 
 
 Features 
 This module adds new options to the Manage Display tab on your entities. It will add a new component selector to render your data using any component in your site. It supports:

 
 Rendering a field using a component. 
 Rendering a group of fields using a component, via Field Group . Each individual field could, in turn, be using a component. 
 Rendering an entity using a component. Each individual field, and field groups, could, in turn, be using a component. 
 Rendering an entity with nested components. See how .
